GMB.note: The document names the commission only as the body given data protection oversight; it states nothing about the access to information law or its rules or decisions.

facts.fact: Minister Lamin Jabbi said in a radio interview that The Gambia 'already ha[s] a law in place', a 2025 data protection law.

Minister Jabbi said oversight of data protection has been assigned to the Access to Information Authority's commissioners so one commission regulates both, and that the commissioners were being trained.

GMB.note: The document mentions biometrics only as personal data left online; it states nothing about a national ID system.
